bandReport.notes: Band p08-p14 = printed pages 19-A, 21-A, 23-A, 25-A, 27-A, 29-A, 31-A. Per page: p08 Q55-60 (6), p09 Q61-67 (7), p10 Q68-75 (8), p11 Q76-83 (8), p12 Q84-90 (7), p13 Q91-96 (6), p14 Q97-100 (4). NO Directions / shared-stimulus set anywhere in this band — every question in p08-p14 is standalone, so no context/setLabel is used. Neighbour territory: p07 (printed 17-A, band b1) carries Q49, Q50 and a 'Consider the following for the next 04 (four) items that follow' block (the Class XII Biology/Physics/Chemistry percentage stimulus) whose four members Q51-54 are ALL printed on p07 itself — that set opens and closes on p07, so nothing straddles into this band and b1 owns all of it. p14 is the last page of the booklet: it ends at Q100 with the footer '(31-A)' and no further question is begun, so the paper genuinely ends at Q100. NO ANSWER KEY appears anywhere on p08-p14. Figures: Q91-Q100 are figure-bearing (10 of them, the whole geometry/mensuration closing block) and carry hasFigure + figureNote; no question earlier in the band has a diagram. Two invented subtopics are flagged (Q55 'Scales of Measurement', Q82 'Comparison of Areas for Equal Perimeter') plus Q88 filed under Circles because the catalog has no locus/coordinate-geometry chapter. Decimals printed with the booklet's raised middle dot are transcribed with a full stop per the brief (Q67 1.5, Q73 2.5, Q75 14.9/14.7/14.5/14.3, Q77 8.4/6.5/4.2/3.2, Q96 8.2/5.2/10.4/4.1/2.6, Q98 186.3/769.5); every one was checked at zoom and is a decimal, not a multiplication or a time separator. 'cosec' is transcribed as \operatorname{cosec} (Q65, Q67), matching the printed glyph and the dominant convention in the sibling band files.
